name: Hi-Light 航轮 R9 FORCE PR1600
why_interesting: A premium titanium road-bike benchmark with a complete manufacturer BOM, claimed complete weight and official China reference price.

facts.drivetrain: SRAM Force 22 mechanical 2×11; Force front and rear derailleurs, Force 50/34T crank, Force 11–32T cassette and SRAM PC1130 chain
facts.complete_weight_basis: Manufacturer-listed complete-bike weight; size, pedals and measurement method are not stated
facts.frame: Hi-Light R9 titanium frame with R9 Carbon fork
facts.frame_material: Titanium frame with carbon fork; the CNC-integrated dropouts are specifically 3Al–2.5V titanium, while the main-tube grade is not published
facts.frame_construction: Hydroformed, shaped and butted titanium tubes with CNC-integrated dropouts, CNC head tube, 3D-integrated bottom-bracket shell and internal cable routing
facts.stiffness_evidence: The exact R9 page confirms hydroformed tubes, and the manufacturer says its hydroforming process improves overall and local stiffness. No independent exact-model deflection, torsion or laboratory comparison was found across the 50-area sweep, so this remains a source-qualified construction claim.
facts.frame_weight_basis: Manufacturer-listed R9 frame weight; size, hardware and measurement method are not stated
facts.tire_clearance_basis: Manufacturer maximum: 700×28C on the exact R9 frame
facts.cockpit: Controltech ACT 31.8 handlebar and stem with ACT 27.2 seatpost and ACT 41.8–52 headset
facts.brakes: SRAM Force hydraulic controls and brakes
facts.sizes: XS, S, M, L and XL; custom sizing offered

missing: Independent complete-bike weight measurement with size and pedal basis
Independent exact-model stiffness or deflection measurement
Current mainland checkout observation, domestic warranty issuer and invoice handling

official_price.price_basis: Manufacturer-listed retail price for the exact R9 Force PR1600 complete-bike record; no current mainland checkout was observed

source_note: The exact official complete-bike and R9 frame pages were rechecked through search indexes on 2026-09-23; the result crawls are about two months old and direct opens returned 403. Existing 8.3 kg, Force 22 BOM, CNY 22,900 official reference price, titanium/carbon frame-and-fork, 700x28C maximum, and construction-based stiffness claims remain qualified; no current checkout or measured stiffness result was obtained.
